name: Radiative Gaussian Splatting
definition: A scene representation using a set of learnable 3D Gaussian kernels (radiative Gaussians) to model isotropic density fields for tomographic reconstruction, replacing the view-dependent color/opacity of standard 3DGS with central density.
summary: Radiative Gaussian Splatting reconstructs 3D density volumes from X-ray projections by replacing view-dependent color with view-independent scalar density, unlike standard 3D Gaussian Splatting.
